CommunityLevel.title: CommunityLevel
CommunityLevel.description: A user-created maze level and visual biome published to Online Disinfestation.

title.description: Display title of the community map.

description.description: Short tactical note written by the creator.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the level creator.

authorName.description: Display nickname of the level creator.

customWallColor.description: Optional hex wall tint (#RRGGBB) or empty string.

customFloorColor.description: Optional hex floor tint (#RRGGBB) or empty string.

difficulty.description: Locked difficulty preset chosen by the creator.

objectiveMode.description: Win condition mode chosen by the creator.

criticalLimit.description: Maximum rat population before overcrowding defeat (30-250).

breedCooldown.description: Cooldown in seconds between breeding cycles.

layout.description: Grid rows of '#' walls and '.' paths (9-100 rows, 11-100 cols).

tunnels.description: Up to 4 linked floor or wall tunnel pairs.

initialRats.description: 2 to 50 initial rat spawn coordinates and sexes.

isPublished.description: Whether the level is publicly playable by the community.

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest recorded completion time in milliseconds (0 if uncompleted).

bestScore.description: Highest recorded score for survival mode (0 if uncompleted).

bestEliminatedCount.description: Eliminated rat count from the record run (primary metric for survival; tie-breaker for eradication).

bestBabiesEliminatedCount.description: Baby rats eliminated during the record run (tie-breaker for target_kills).

bestPlayerName.description: Display nickname of the record holder.

LevelRun.title: LevelRun
LevelRun.description: Personal best completion run for a player on a specific community level.

runnerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

playerName.description: Public display nickname of the player.

eliminatedCount.description: Total rats eliminated during the record run.

babiesEliminatedCount.description: Baby rats eliminated during the record run (tie-breaker for target_kills).

bornCount.description: Rats born during the record run.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for leaderboard listing.

StoryLevelSummary.title: StoryLevelSummary
StoryLevelSummary.description: Public leaderboard summary record per (levelId, difficulty) for an official Story Mode level (1-30).

difficulty.description: Difficulty tier isolated for this Story leaderboard.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for listing Story summaries.

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest recorded completion time in milliseconds.

bestEliminatedCount.description: Eliminated rat count of the current Story record run.

bestBabiesEliminatedCount.description: Baby rats eliminated in the current Story record run.

bestPlayerName.description: Nickname of the current Story record holder.

playCount.description: Total recorded Story clears for this level & difficulty.

StoryRun.title: StoryRun
StoryRun.description: Personal best official leaderboard run for a player on a Story Mode (levelId, difficulty).

runnerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

playerName.description: Public display nickname of the player.

difficulty.description: Difficulty preset used on the record run.

objectiveMode.description: Objective mode of the Story level.

eliminatedCount.description: Rats eliminated during the record run.

babiesEliminatedCount.description: Baby rats eliminated during the record run.

bornCount.description: Rats born during the record run.

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for leaderboard listing.

/community_levels/{levelId}.description: Publicly shared community levels created by players.

/community_levels/{levelId}/runs/{runner.description: Personal best completion runs for each community level.

/story_levels/{summaryId}.description: Official Story Mode per-level and per-difficulty ({levelId}_{difficulty}) record summaries.

/story_levels/{summaryId}/runs/{runnerId.description: Personal best Story Mode leaderboard runs isolated per level and difficulty.
